<!-- Read CONTRIBUTING before submitting. Suspected vulnerabilities follow SECURITY; do not disclose them here. / 提交前请阅读贡献指南；疑似漏洞请按安全政策处理，不要在此披露。 -->
[Contributing / 贡献指南](https://github.com/Socrems/Triloa/blob/development/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security / 安全政策](https://github.com/Socrems/Triloa/security/policy)

### Change and reason / 修改与原因

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if any. / 说明问题及修改后的行为；如有相关议题可附链接。

### Verification / 验证

Describe relevant automated or manual checks and results, or why a check was not run. For documentation-only changes, check wording and links; tests and rebuilds are not required. / 说明相关自动或手动检查及结果，或未运行检查的原因。仅修改文档时检查文字与链接，无需测试或重新打包。

### Notes (optional) / 补充说明（可选）

Mention remaining limitations or relevant UI evidence, with personal data removed. / 可说明剩余限制或提供相关界面材料，请先移除个人数据。
